requirements.title: Standard Resume Files
requirements.definition: Provide a clean, professionally formatted Standard resume in editable Word and PDF formats.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers delivery and formatting of the Standard resume files; ATS compatibility, substantive content, and the Signature design are independently testable behaviors.

requirements.title: Resume ATS Compatibility
requirements.definition: Format the Standard resume so automated applicant-tracking systems can reliably process it for online applications.
requirements.boundary_note: ATS processing is independently testable from whether Word and PDF files exist and from the visual design of the Signature resume.

requirements.title: Signature Resume Design
requirements.definition: Provide a visually designed Signature resume with a custom Canva-based layout, typography, and personal branding for direct outreach and networking.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently deliverable visual presentation of the Signature resume, not its shared substantive content or the Standard resume files.

requirements.title: Standard Cover Letter Files
requirements.definition: Provide a clean Standard version of the tailored cover letter in the package's conventional document formats.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the Standard cover-letter deliverable; its narrative tailoring and Signature visual design can be changed and assessed separately.

requirements.title: Signature Cover Letter Design
requirements.definition: Provide a visually designed Signature cover letter aligned with the design style of the Signature resume.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the Signature cover letter's visual presentation and alignment with the Signature resume, not its narrative content.

requirements.title: Content Consistency Across Editions
requirements.definition: Keep the substantive content consistent between each document's Standard and Signature editions so that presentation, rather than meaning, is the principal difference.
requirements.boundary_note: Cross-edition consistency is independently testable even when all four document variants have been delivered.

requirements.title: Remote-Role Application Positioning
requirements.definition: Position the resume and cover letter for a transition into remote work while allowing consideration of new role types beyond the client's prior assistant roles.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the cross-document occupational direction; factual resume details, accomplishment writing, and cover-letter voice remain separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Resume Factual Accuracy
requirements.definition: Represent the client's employment timeline, overlapping work, education credentials, and other biographical facts accurately in the resume.
requirements.boundary_note: Dates, concurrent-work notation, and credential details are attributes of one factual-accuracy mechanism rather than separate Requirements for every resume field.

requirements.title: Resume Strengths and Accomplishments Narrative
requirements.definition: Present the client's relevant skills, accomplishments, and experience through strategically written resume summaries, competencies, and achievement-focused bullets.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers persuasive presentation of strengths and achievements, which can be revised independently from factual accuracy, role targeting, or visual formatting.

requirements.title: Tailored Cover Letter Narrative
requirements.definition: Write a non-generic cover letter in the client's voice that complements the resume and communicates suitability for the targeted kinds of roles.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers voice and narrative tailoring; document formatting and the broader remote-role targeting decision are independently changeable.

requirements.title: Included Document Revision Round
requirements.definition: Apply one included round of client-informed revisions to the resume and cover letter artifacts after initial review.
requirements.boundary_note: Retained because it requires concrete changes to the delivered artifacts; generic review invitations, turnaround estimates, and scheduling are excluded.
